Introduction
The purpose of the &IdPGroup; package is to implement identification functions for different p-groups, which are implemented in the &SmallGrps; library, but lack an effective identification routine in it. The first function identifies the groups of order 512. This is done by calculating a number of invariants of a given group and comparing them with the values of all possible candidates via a precalculated search tree. More details can be found in section .
Section introduces the definitions of (strong) siblings and includes functions to load all such sets of groups of certain order.
Functions that were used to calculate these lists of groups and which can be used to calculate them for different orders can be found in section .
Once such sets of groups are determined one might want to examine them further by checking certain properties and calculating additionaly invariants. In Section one can find functions to calculate some selected invarants and properties for such sets and export them into LaTeX-readable lines of code.
Finally section describes all funcions that were used to build the search tree in the descirbed identification routine and which can be used to build other such trees.
